thread:
University of Maryland, Baltimore has more restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus than Johns Hopkins, Morgan State and Loyola Maryland combined.

Every Baltimore college with 5,000+ students:

1. University of Maryland, Baltimore: 111
2. Johns Hopkins: 76
3. Morgan State: 18
4. Loyola Maryland: 5
5. UMBC: 4

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/campus/md
